Gold imports thru Dhaka customs plunge over 99% in 3 years
items.description: Gold imports through Customs House Dhaka fell by more than 99 percent in three years, with industry insiders and officials blaming hiked duties, tightened baggage rules and lengthy procedures.

items.title: 27,000 online businesses identified for VAT scrutiny
items.description: The National Board of Revenue (NBR) has identified around 27,000 e-commerce businesses, most without a business identification number (BIN), for potential VAT scrutiny as part of efforts to bring online businesses into the formal tax system
